headline: YouTube is rolling out its Gemini-powered Ask YouTube assistant to all mobile users in the US, no longer only to Premium subscribers.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a free AI feature for a very large video platform, but a gradual US-only rollout of an existing tool.
importance_line: YouTube viewers in the US can ask an AI questions about videos and beyond without paying, but the rollout is gradual, limited to US phones for now, and the Shorts and live-stream versions come later.
summary: 9to5Google reports that Google announced on Tuesday that Ask YouTube, a conversational AI tool powered by Gemini that answers questions about videos and beyond, is rolling out to all users on Android and iOS in the US, no longer only to Premium subscribers, after reaching TV apps first. Use from Shorts and during live streams is planned for a later release, and Google says it will expand availability gradually.
